title: The Silence of the Lambs
synopsis: FBI Academy. A senator's daughter is missing. Hannibal Lecter has a profile to share, but only for a song.

nodes.text: Quantico woods. Crawford pulls you off the course.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Listen” back. Path shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Curious.

nodes.text: He flirts grossly. He hands you the case file.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Discipline.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: The lambs, when you try to sleep, are quieter.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Survive—follows you into whatever comes next.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You serve, decades, with distinction. Lecter does not come for you. The lambs, eventually, do quiet. You sleep.
You move to Quantico as an instructor. You shape a generation. You meet your own students at lunch sometimes, twenty years on, and they call you ma'am.
A phone rings, decades on. You let it. You realize, late, that some shadows are also, in their way, witnesses to who you became.
